highlights.name: ♟️ Reinforcement Learning for Chess
highlights.description: Exploring self-play and learning-based decision-making in chess.
details: PPO agents and comparisons with random, Syzygy, and Stockfish agents.
Experiments with endgame positions and multi-GPU training.

highlights.name: 🔴🟡 Connect Four Agents
highlights.description: A compact environment for studying competitive reinforcement learning.
details: Masked action selection and efficient board representations.
Evaluation against random and search-based opponents.

highlights.name: ⛏️ Minecraft Reinforcement Learning
highlights.description: Exploring the challenges of learning in richer interactive environments.
details: Working with observation and action interfaces.
Investigating CPU environment execution with GPU-based agents.
Exploring longer-horizon learning and evaluation workflows.

highlights.name: 🕷️ Spider-Bot
highlights.description: A robotics project bringing together software and physical interaction.
